quotes.text: Graph rebases now operate directly in the selected repository: remove `taskManager.prepareCurrent("rebase", ...)` and `taskManager.prepareCurrent("interactive-rebase", ...)` from `commands/graph/server.mjs`; `rebase-session-store.mjs` accepts ordinary graph sessions. Regression coverage confirms no `git worktree` invocation and no mutation/copy of source edits or old `.tb-review-*` directories. [Task 2]
